Market probabilities, bid/ask and volume are venue-specific and may be illiquid or stale. No wallet, trading, order-placement or execution functionality is connected. Availability and access depend on each provider's terms and local jurisdiction.

Research integrity

Every displayed feed should retain its provider, retrieval time, data-as-of timestamp, and freshness state. Public APIs are used where available. CME/ICE real-time quotes, full-depth order books, redistribution rights, professional newswires and licensed intraday datasets require separate commercial permissions and are not presented as free.
